/* 스팟 미리보기 단건 조회 */ SELECT s.id, s.name, s.theme, s.user_id, COALESCE(s.bookmark_count, 0) AS bookmark_count,
ROUND(CAST( ST_Distance( s.location::geography, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{lng}, #{lat}), 4326)::geography ) / 1000.0 AS numeric ), 2)
NULL::numeric
AS distance_km, s.address AS address_simple, s.address_road, s.address_jibun FROM spots s WHERE s.id = #{spotId} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
